integrity: The conclusion follows from a complete fixed-point proof for all unary term operations, with two replayable independent implementations and a separate directed-simulation obstruction. Scientific peer review and independent validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only one propositional variable and frames with at most two worlds; parameter variables and larger frames are not classified. Previously known full-cluster and D1 cases are not claimed to be new.
title: A sharp two-world boundary for unary modal positivity
